headline: Kuura Flares as Expanse and Mooring Grind On
war_summary: Three hours on brings a new flare at Kuura Strand with eight changes in the last two hours about Suosalo and Faden Point, now listed six bases to the Wardens, after sharp but cooling casualty returns. Mooring County remains hard-fought with three changes in two hours and fifty-two in the day about MacConmara Barrows, Gravekeeper's Holdfast and the Cut, counted ten Warden to two Colonial with day losses near seven thousand nine hundred Colonial and eight thousand seven hundred Warden and both rates accelerating. The Weathered Expanse endures as the heaviest field with three changes in two hours and seventy in the day about Wightwalk and Frostmarch, now six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral with day losses of eight thousand eight hundred Colonial and eleven thousand five hundred Warden. Marban Hollow has gone quiet in the last two hours after seventeen changes in the day about Checkpoint Bua, now one Warden, six Colonial and one neutral. Linn Mercy shows no change in two hours since the Lathair business, while Stlican Shelf, Palantine Berm and Godcrofts record nothing in six hours though the Nevish Line, Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle still report heavy losses without a flip.
